title: Lightning TV TOI service-stream v2 — DESIGN ONLY
description: Proposed contract only. No /api/v2 endpoints or v2 WebSocket handler are implemented. The current runtime remains HTTP commands plus a receive-only v1 update stream.
$comment: Validate with Draft 2020-12 and UUID format assertions. This schema checks message structure, not authentication, permissions, cursor signatures, byte limits, journal ordering, authority ownership or session-state transitions. V1_* definitions are generated from current backend/toi/schemas.py and checked by scripts/validate_service_interface.py --check-v1. LiveState intentionally omits unbounded event/shift histories.

Cursor.description: Opaque game/generation-bound journal position; includes a valid zero position. Never parse or compare cursor text.
